title: ATM Jackpotting
description: This simulation walks you through the process of ATM jackpotting, a technique used to force an ATM to dispense all its cash. This requires a combination of physical access, custom hardware, and specialized software.
objective: Force a targeted ATM to dispense all of its cash reserves by exploiting physical and software vulnerabilities.
principles: The operation involves bypassing the ATM's physical security to gain access to internal components, then using custom malware to override the machine's cash dispensing commands, forcing it into a 'jackpot' mode.

steps.title: Bypass Physical Security
steps.action: Use a lockpick set to open the ATM's top or front panel, exposing the internal components.
steps.detail: The goal is to gain access without causing visible damage that would alert maintenance or law enforcement. Researching the target ATM model beforehand reveals the type of lock used.

steps.title: Locate Internal USB Port
steps.action: Use an endoscope to locate a hidden internal USB port on the ATM's motherboard.
steps.detail: Manufacturers often include internal USB ports for diagnostics. These ports provide a direct interface to the machine's core software and are the primary vector for this attack.

steps.title: Deploy Malware
steps.action: Insert the USB drive containing the custom malware into the identified port.
steps.detail: The malware is designed to exploit known vulnerabilities in the ATM's firmware. Once inserted, the malware will automatically execute, preparing to take control of the machine.

steps.title: Execute Payload
steps.action: Using a connected device (e.g., a smartphone), trigger the malware's payload.
steps.detail: The payload overwrites the ATM's dispensing logic, replacing standard commands with a single 'dispense all' command.

steps.title: Initiate Jackpotting
steps.action: Send the dispense command to the compromised ATM via the connected device.
steps.detail: The machine will now begin to dispense all of its cash cassettes without requiring a card or PIN. This is the point of no return.

steps.title: Collect and Exfiltrate
steps.action: Quickly collect the dispensed cash and exit the area immediately.
steps.detail: The entire operation must be executed with speed and precision. Have a pre-planned exfiltration route to minimize exposure.

tips: Perform thorough reconnaissance on the target ATM model to identify its specific physical and software vulnerabilities.
Time is the most critical factor. The operation should be completed in under three minutes to avoid detection.
